name: Haprock
title: Warehouse Keeper

warehouse/30255.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Haprock: Welcome! Here at the Iron Gate Guild, we keep your items safe for a low, low price. We barely make a profit! Besides, you can't put a price tag on peace of mind!

warehouse/30255-noteach.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Haprock: See here, I teach Dwarven Fighters, Scavengers and Bounty Hunters only. If you are an Artisan, you should go to a Blacksmith.

Q00167_DwarvenKinship/30255-01.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Haprock: Ah, a letter from Carlon. Let me see ... Oh ... Hmm ... The operations profit of the warehouse increased twofold in the first half of the year ... Good ... Very good ... The guild leader will be satisfied ... Carlon is more competent than I expected ...

links.text: Ask him why he is reading other people's letters

Q00167_DwarvenKinship/30255-05.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Haprock: Hey! You haven't left yet? Hurry to the village of Gludin , for the sake of my friend Norman, who is anxiously awaiting his wife's letter. Go to the warehouse in the village of Gludin and ask for Norman .

Q00167_DwarvenKinship/30255-02.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Haprock: ... What the! Are you still here? Dear, dear ...! Thank you for bringing Carlon's Letter. By the way, if you plan to travel along the western shores, can I ask you a favor? It is not a difficult task; just delivering a letter to my kinsman in the village of Gludin ...

links.text: Say you will do the favor

Q00167_DwarvenKinship/30255-03.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Haprock: First, take this! It may not be much, but please accept it as a token of thanks for your work.
